memoryBuilder.verseText: Peter said: 'God really does not have favourites!'

sequence.prompt: How did Peter learn that God has no favourites? Put it in order.

items.label: An angel told Cornelius to send for Peter
Peter had the same dream three times
The messengers knocked at the gate
God's Spirit came on everybody there

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: Peter was slow to change his mind

application.question: Peter walked into a house he had always avoided. Who could you welcome in?
application.followUp: God did not win Peter round with an argument — He gave him the same dream three times, because Peter was that slow. Then the Spirit came on everyone in the room while Peter was still talking. God has no favourites.
